jobs.description:
Ready to welcome, wow and work around your schedule?Dual-branded. Double the experience. IHCP is looking for part-time Front Office Crew Members to join our Moxy & Residence Inn by Marriott hotel in the iconic Muzentoren, right in the heart of The Hague.Two brands, one building, 311 rooms. Part of Marriott International, the world's biggest hospitality company, our hotel opened in August 2022 and is proudly the largest hotel in The Hague.This role is perfect if you're studying, looking for a weekend, evening or night job, or simply don't want (or can't) work full-time but still want to be part of something big.Moxy is bold, playful and social, where guests grab a drink, play a game and connect.
Residence Inn is all about longer stays and feeling at home, with a lounge where guests live, work and relax.One shift you're in full Moxy mode, the next you're creating that warm Residence Inn welcome. Best of both worlds? Always. • Creating exceptional guest experiences together with the team
• Processing guest check-ins and check-outs
• Confirming reservations, assigning rooms and activating key cards
• Handling payments and resolving late or disputed charges
• Answering and processing guest calls, messages and requests
• Providing directions and local recommendations
• Serving food & beverages when needed
• Keeping your work area clean, organized and HACCP-compliant
• Taking care of front office equipment
• Supporting the team and contributing to a positive work environment
• Sharing local tips and unique discoveries with guests
